    private static long findMinimum(long target, long[] base, Map<Long, Long> dp) {
        if (target == 0) return 0;

                long diff = base[i] - target;
                q = diff / base[i - 1];
                long option2 = i + 1 + i * q + findMinimum(base[i] - base[i - 1] * q - target, base, dp);
                
                long minVal = Math.min(option1, option2);
